reviews.summary: HOT entered a live HOT→HoloFuel migration on November 1, 2026. The swap/bridge is run by a newly assigned operator under a 90-day provisional licence, creating immediate transition, regulatory, and operational uncertainty for HOT holders.
materialRisks: Live asset-transition event: HOT can now be bridged and swapped 1:1 into HoloFuel; a completed swap is irreversible, while HoloFuel has no external trading venue under the published terms. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

The operator’s licence is provisional for 90 days from November 1, 2026 and may be amended, suspended, revoked, or not renewed; this can halt further swap/bridge operations. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

The migration changes operational custody/contract risk: only Ethereum HOT is supported, while Base and Arbitrum HOT cannot be bridged; the official terms explicitly allow suspension for security, legal, or regulatory reasons. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

facts.fact: Holo Limited published a November 1, 2026 notice assigning responsibility for the HOT redemption mechanism to Net Zero FZC. ([holo.host](https://holo.host/resources/schedule1notice))
The official HoloFuel site states the network and HOT-to-HoloFuel swap are open. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/))
The published terms set a minimum six-month swap window, with at least 60 days’ notice before closure. ([netzero.zone](https://netzero.zone/platform-terms.html))

Holo’s current status page reports Marketplace, Gateway, REST API, and Dashboard operational as of November 4, 2026; no current service outage was identified. ([status.holo.ag](https://status.holo.ag/))
